summary: Recovered both staged jobs into the persistent CUPS raw queue `archive`. Their original bytes and spool files were preserved, and node1 passed the mandatory restart/recovery check.

Created an atomic, retry-safe electronic archive backend writing to /srv/legacy2/print-spool-recovery/printed.
Submitted J100 and J101 exactly once as raw jobs.
Verified two manifest jobs, two completed CUPS jobs, and two byte-identical archive files.
Restarted node1 and verified the queue, service, backend, original files, and archived data recovered.
